hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are nursing a Saturday hangover after a rare two-goal deficit snapped a 72-game streak, with Timber's injury scare for Netherlands adding to the treatment room anxiety. The Opta supercomputer isn't singing from the Emirates hymn sheet, and there's grumbling about missed transfer targets, yet the underlying numbers still scream dominance — 28 points clear of Leeds, a women's side in UWCL action, and cannons firing from Ghana to the US Virgin Islands. Typical Arsenal: statistically supreme, nervously awaiting the next twist.

daily.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment swung wildly across the day: a post-Brighton meltdown (3/10) gave way to midday optimism fueled by title-favorite models (8/10), before settling into an evening of lingering frustration over defensive frailties and transfer near-misses (4/10).

weekly.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment traced a dramatic boom-and-bust arc across the week: cautious optimism early on built into bullish, title-chasing euphoria by mid-week, only to implode catastrophically after a 3-0 loss at Brighton on the 19th. The final two days saw sentiment plummet from peak confidence (8/10) to meltdown and despair (3/10), with Arteta's 'lack of respect' critique, exposed defensive frailties, and extinguished title hopes defining a thoroughly miserable finish.
